The winding passages of the grotto are known to but few, who guard that knowledge jealously, out of fear or greed. }} This northern remote and little known underground passage named the [[Basalt Grotto]] connects the Desolation to Vabbi. ==Getting there== Basalt Grotto lies between the northwestern corner of [[Vehjin Mines]] in [[Vabbi]] and the northeastern corner of [[Joko's Domain]] in [[the Desolation]]. Either travel northwest from [[Jennur's Horde (outpost)|Jennur's Horde]] or travel northeast from the [[Bone Palace]]. It is an optional outpost.
